10 REM SL V3.2: LOAD &C100, SAVE &C200
30 CLEAR:WAIT 0:BEEP OFF:A=49408
40 H=PEEK(63589):S=(H+128-256*INT(H/128))*256+PEEK(63590)
42 IF S>49151 AND S<A+391 THEN PRINT "NO ROOM":BEEP 3:END
50 D=0:INPUT "BAUD (ENTER=9600) ";D

60 PRINT "INSTALLING"
70 RESTORE 1000:READ N:C=0
80 FOR S=1 TO N:READ O,L
90 FOR I=0 TO L-1:READ B:POKE A+O+I,B:C=C+B:NEXT I
100 NEXT S
110 READ X:IF X<>C THEN GOTO 900
112 T=3000000/D
114 Q=INT((T-100)/4+.5):GOSUB 200:POKE A+335,U:POKE A+340,V
116 Q=INT((T-99)/4+.5):GOSUB 200:POKE A+86,U:POKE A+113,U
117 POKE A+91,V:POKE A+118,V
118 Q=INT((T/2-105)/4+.5):GOSUB 200:POKE A+58,U:POKE A+63,V
120 P=PEEK(65084)+256*PEEK(65085)
140 IF P<32768 THEN GOTO 910
150 CLS:PRINT "SAVER/LOADER READY ";D
160 PRINT "LOAD: CALL&C100, NEW first"
170 PRINT "SAVE: CALL&C200"
190 END
200 U=INT((Q+3)/4):IF U<1 THEN LET U=1
205 V=4*U-Q:IF V>8 THEN LET V=8
207 RETURN
900 PRINT "DATA ERROR":BEEP 3:END
910 PRINT "POINTERS?":BEEP 3:END
